svg.aria-label: The recorded trace has 4 instants, 0 to 3. The requirement F[0,3] p2 asks for signal s2 to hold at some instant from 0 to 3. Signal s2 is false at every one of those instants, so the deadline is missed and the verdict is false at time 0. R2U2 reports the same verdict.
